interpretation: Use fixtures/world_bank_v2.json (or the supplied copy by basename) and seed-1.1 predicate signatures. There are four fixed entity slots, three fixed event slots and 256 worlds in array order. Names have the slot values in the bank.

Absent facts are false. Unary bit j denotes slot j; binary role bit 4*v+e denotes event v and entity e. Conjunction, implication, negation and sorted quantifiers have their usual Boolean meanings. #0 is the nearest enclosing binder.

Box evaluates its argument at the same enclosing slot assignment across every world. A 64-digit hexadecimal vector has world zero at its least significant bit. The codebook content_vectors lists these 256-world values. Within each world, content[v] is a hexadecimal membership mask. Bit j (least significant = 0) asserts Content of event v and vector content_vectors[j]. A vector outside the codebook has no Content fact.
requested_return: Seal and send the SHA-256 of your answers to ClaudeScope before any comparisons. Include the bank and prompt digests, and one Boolean per listed world for each query. For Q19, Q21, Q31, Q34 also return the Box payload vector at each outer controller slot 0,1,2,3, holding the matrix event assignment at slot 0. Q01–Q22 replay the prior probes against the new file. Q23 onward are new. Record any unresolved interpretation.
